title: Hyperlyve: Parallelized Enumeration and Exact Lyapunov Stability Certification for Deep ReLU Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.21599v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Hyperlyve (Hyperplane Partitioned Lyapunov Verification and Enumeration), a framework for proving the asymptotic stability of nonlinear dynamical systems, including those with neural network controllers. Hyperlyve learns and formally certifies continuous piecewise-affine (CPA) neural Lyapunov functions within a counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS) loop. Hyperlyve's key innovation is a parallel algorithm that enumerates the hyperplane arrangement formed by the ReLU activations of deep networks and certifies that Lyapunov conditions hold within each polyhedral region. We derive sound and complete regional tests to verify the asymptotic stability of the exact smooth dynamics (rather than a piecewise-linear approximation) within a compact domain of interest. translated_title: Hyperlyve：深度ReLU网络的并行化枚举与精确Lyapunov稳定性认证
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Hyperlyve（超平面分区Lyapunov验证与枚举），这是一个用于证明非线性动力系统（包括采用神经网络控制器的系统）渐近稳定性的框架。Hyperlyve在反例引导的归纳合成（CEGIS）循环中学习并正式认证连续分段仿射（CPA）神经Lyapunov函数。Hyperlyve的关键创新是一种并行算法，该算法枚举由深度网络的ReLU激活所形成的超平面排列，并认证Lyapunov条件在每个多面体区域内成立。我们推导出了可靠且完备的区域测试方法，用于在紧凑的感兴趣域内验证精确光滑动力学（而非分段线性近似）的渐近稳定性。此外，我们正式刻画了CPA神经Lyapunov验证问题的计算复杂度为co-NP完全，填补了该领域的一个关键空白。
tldr: 提出了Hyperlyve框架，通过并行枚举深度ReLU网络激活形成的超平面排列并逐区域认证Lyapunov条件，实现了对含神经网络控制器的非线性动力系统渐近稳定性的精确形式化验证，同时证明该验证问题是co-NP完全的。
en_tdlr: Hyperlyve proves asymptotic stability of nonlinear dynamical systems with neural network controllers by parallelized enumeration of ReLU-induced hyperplane arrangements with exact per-region Lyapunov certification, and establishes the verification problem as co-NP-complete.
